facts.what: 拒绝只吃一点肉汁饭；认为 George 的「洋葱过敏」是夸张
facts.anchor: He’s allergic to onions – or so he says.

facts.what: 提出把肉让出、只吃未浇肉汁的土豆泥和蔬菜，向 Maria 道歉
facts.anchor: I’ll just have some of the mash and veg that’s not got any gravy on it yet

facts.what: 没吃早饭来赴午餐；Maria 仍忽视她
facts.anchor: especially since I didn’t eat any breakfast to avoid spoiling this stupid lunch

facts.what: 再次叫错名字 Bianca，问 Blair 做什么工作；随后改口 Becca
facts.anchor: ‘So, Bianca,’ she suddenly starts. ‘What is it you do?’

facts.what: 说辞职是 George 的主意、他说她 destined for greater things
facts.anchor: ‘He said I’m destined for greater things.’

facts.what: 「自雇」说法是 George 教她的标准答案；十六岁起打工自立
facts.anchor: ‘Self-employed, I like to call it.’ And force a smile toward Maria. Because that’s what he told me to say if anyone ever asked me.

facts.what: 解释自己辞职安排：钱够、不愿她被醉汉吹口哨；不接受拒绝
facts.anchor: he wouldn’t feel comfortable with me being wolf-whistled at by drunken men if we were to be together

facts.what: 只做两份甜点，暗示挑食者不配；Blair 脑内幻想把她按进微波炉
facts.anchor: I doubt the fussy eater in the corner would be able to bear such delight.

relations: Blair 与 George 同居、经济依赖他；Maria 敌意升级；George 全程不替 Blair 说话
